name: Mockuuups Studio
summary: Mockup generator with 5,300+ device and print templates, design-tool plugins and a desktop app.
description: Drop a screenshot into the web generator and export it inside phone, laptop, desktop, smartwatch, TV or print scenes; 5,300+ templates, some with transparent or 3D-rendered backgrounds. Available as a browser tool, plugins for Figma, Sketch, Penpot, Adobe Express and Frontify, a Mac/Windows/Linux desktop app, and an API for automated renders.
contains: device mockups: phone, tablet, laptop, desktop, smartwatch, TV
print mockups: business card, poster, book, paper
scenes up to 6700x5000 px, some with transparent backgrounds
plugins for Figma, Sketch, Penpot, Adobe Express and Frontify
desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux
Mockup Generator API and custom photoshoot service
5 free trial exports; free mockup collection with attribution
